verified_facts.text: The resort overlooks Palm Springs, the Coachella Valley and the San Jacinto Mountain Range.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking Palm Springs, Coachella Valley, and the San Jacinto Mountain Range, The Ritz-Carlton, Rancho Mirage offers an elevated experience of a timeless destination.

verified_facts.text: The Edge Steakhouse is set on a cliff above the Coachella Valley and serves steaks, seafood and craft cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on a cliff above the Coachella Valley, this modern Palm Springs steakhouse features global steaks, seafood, craft cocktails, breathtaking views

verified_facts.text: State Fare Bar & Kitchen serves a menu of seasonal ingredients alongside offerings from local wineries and small-batch distilleries.

verified_facts.text: Air Pool Bar serves made-to-order burgers, salads and cocktails by the hotel pool.

verified_facts.text: The pool area offers VIP-style cabanas for private dining.

verified_facts.text: Guests at The Edge Steakhouse receive a complimentary welcome drink, The Edge old-fashioned, smoked under a cloche.
